record.original_question: Does there exist a group von Neumann algebra L(G) that is pseudocompact, meaning elementarily equivalent to some tracial matrix ultraproduct M_U = ∏_{n→U} M_n(C)? And does there exist an icc non-inner-amenable group G for which L(G) is not pseudocompact?

evidence.quote: Problem 4. Does there exist a group von Neumann algebra L(G) that is pseudocompact? Does there exist an icc non inner amenable group von Neumann algebra L(G) that is not pseudocompact?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Notation and setup. Let $\mathbb{C}$ denote the complex numbers and for each integer $n\ge 1$ let $M_n(\mathbb{C})$ be the $n\times n$ complex matrix algebra equipped with its normalized trace $\mathrm{tr}_n$. Fix a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$ and form the tracial matrix ultraproduct
$$M_{\mathcal{U}} \;=\; \prod_{n\to\mathcal{U}} M_n(\mathbb{C}),$$
viewed as a tracial von Neumann algebra in the language of tracial von Neumann algebras (the continuous first-order language used for $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors). Two tracial von Neumann algebras are called elementarily equivalent if they satisfy the same sentences in this language.

For a countable discrete group $G$, let $L(G)$ denote the associated group von Neumann algebra (the weak-operator closure of the left regular representation of $G$ on $\ell^2(G)$), endowed with its canonical trace. The group $G$ is said to be icc (infinite conjugacy class) if every nontrivial conjugacy class of $G$ is infinite, and $G$ is said to be inner amenable if $G$ admits a finitely additive conjugation-invariant mean on $G\setminus\{e\}$.

A tracial von Neumann algebra $M$ is called pseudocompact if it is elementarily equivalent to $M_{\mathcal{U}}$ for some (equivalently, every) free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$.

Questions.
(a) Does there exist a countable discrete group $G$ such that the group von Neumann algebra $L(G)$ is pseudocompact?
(b) Does there exist a countable icc group $G$ that is not inner amenable and for which $L(G)$ is not pseudocompact?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as one of 50 open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors (2025). Related literature on pseudocompact tracial von Neumann algebras and elementary equivalence of group von Neumann algebras (e.g., back-and-forth equivalent group factors, exotic II_1 factors without property Gamma) does not appear to resolve either part of the question, so it is reported as open.

status_evidence.title: 50 Open Problems: Ultraproduct II1 factors
status_evidence.snippet: A collection of 50 open problems around the structure theory of ultraproducts of II_1 factors.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem in a 2025 collection of open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors.

status_evidence.title: Back-and-forth equivalent group von Neumann algebras
status_evidence.snippet: There exist elementarily equivalent ICC groups whose group von Neumann algebras are not elementarily equivalent.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies elementary equivalence of group von Neumann algebras but does not exhibit a pseudocompact L(G).

status_evidence.title: An exotic II_1 factor without property Gamma
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions and properties of factors elementarily equivalent to matrix ultraproducts.
status_evidence.claim: Pseudocompact II_1 factors are studied but no group factor example is known.
